catalog_imports_counts_check.name: catalog_imports_counts_check
catalog_imports_counts_check.value:
"catalog_imports"."rows_total" >= 0 AND "catalog_imports"."rows_invalid" >= 0 AND "catalog_imports"."new_count" >= 0 AND "catalog_imports"."changed_count" >= 0
        AND "catalog_imports"."unchanged_count" >= 0 AND "catalog_imports"."missing_count" >= 0 AND "catalog_imports"."price_jump_count" >= 0

channels_risk_accepted_check.name: channels_risk_accepted_check
channels_risk_accepted_check.value: "channels"."connection_type" <> 'unofficial' OR ("channels"."risk_accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channels"."risk_accepted_by" IS NOT NULL)
